raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-16 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver treats both as local. v2 evening transactions therefore land after midnight on the next day, which gives the 00:00-06:00 timestamps and the 33 rows on 2026-01-19. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago local time fixes txn_ts and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
